name: Playa del Carmen

queries.query: Playa del Carmen Mexico official cadastral map parcel cadastre municipal GIS
queries.result: Official municipal Catastro procedure pages were found. They identify the municipal Dirección de Catastro, cadastral cartography, the padrón catastral, and the SIGEM internal system, but no public anonymous parcel geometry endpoint was verified.

queries.query: Playa del Carmen México catastro mapa oficial parcelas GIS
queries.result: La búsqueda identificó la Dirección de Catastro municipal y trámites que usan cartografía catastral, padrón catastral y SIGEM; no se verificó un servicio público anónimo que devolviera identidad nativa segura y geometría de predios.

requestOutcomes.outcome: HTTP 200 official page. It states that Dirección de Catastro reviews cadastral cartography and the municipal padrón, and that the procedure is not online; no parcel feature response or public map API was exposed.
HTTP 200 official page. It describes a printed manzana/parcel location sketch only when a property is registered in the graphic record; no anonymous geometry endpoint was exposed.

HTTP 200 official directory. SIGEM is listed as an internal system and links to sigem.solidaridad.mx; a direct public GET to that hostname failed DNS resolution in this environment. No login, credentials, or bypass was attempted.
HTTP 200 official national platform. The site documents public WMS/WFS-oriented geospatial visualization and downloads, but it did not expose a Playa del Carmen cadastral feature response.

HTTP 200. Current configuration lists RAN rural parcel-related layers and INEGI map services, but no municipal Playa del Carmen parcel layer or safe local cadastral identity was found in the inspected configuration.
HTTP 200, 265913-byte XML capabilities response. Layer names were inspected; no cadastral parcel layer for Playa del Carmen was identified. This is not evidence of citywide absence.
HTTP 200 PNG for a bounded extent around the exact WUP point, but this was a general reference layer and not a parcel feature response; no parcel was inferred from it.
HTTP 403 Access Denied from the public endpoint. No retry with altered identity, CAPTCHA bypass, or TLS relaxation was attempted; no geometry or schema was obtained.
